brief:
Jordan released an Israeli who entered the country by sea from the southern port city of Eilat via the Gulf of Aqaba, Shehab Wire reported. The individual was questioned before being freed, though authorities did not disclose his identity or motives for the infiltration.

The release followed efforts to secure his freedom, according to the report. No further details were provided about the circumstances of the crossing or diplomatic negotiations surrounding the case.

title: Jordan releases Israeli who infiltrated from Eilat by sea
